lines.zh: 我以七条细腿爬过石缝。
lines.en: Seven thin legs carry me through the crack in the stone.

lines.zh: 甲壳摩擦，声音像碎玻璃。
lines.en: My shell rasps like broken glass.

lines.zh: 我钻进墙里，又从另一头出来。
lines.en: I bore into the wall and come out the far side.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，能钻过任何缝。
lines.en: A body this small fits through any gap.

lines.zh: 我沿着地板的纹路往前爬。
lines.en: I follow the seams of the floor forward.

lines.zh: 我游过地板，留下一线水。
lines.en: I swim across the floor, leaving a wet line.
I crawl and probe as I go.

lines.zh: 这具小小的壳，不是原来的。
lines.en: This small shell isn't the one I was born in.
I climb high and walk upside down.

lines.zh: 每一步都在找可以吃的东西。
lines.en: Every step is a search for something to eat.

lines.zh: 我停在墙缝里，动了动触须。
lines.en: I pause in a crack and flex my antennae.
Grit falls on me; I don't dodge.
I skirt the lamp and crawl into the dark.
Many of my kind have crawled this path.

lines.zh: 我爬上你的箱子，你没发现。
lines.en: I climb your chest and you don't notice.

lines.zh: 我的腿太多，走起来很急。
lines.en: Too many legs make me move in a hurry.

lines.zh: 我伏在墙缝里，一动不动。
lines.en: I lie still in the crack.

lines.zh: 触须在空气里探来探去。
lines.en: My antennae probe the air.
This body never stops growing.
I hear what moves inside the walls.

lines.zh: 黏液的味，从我身上散出来。
lines.en: The smell of slime rises off me.

lines.zh: 我躲在石缝里，只露出触须。
lines.en: I hide in a stone crack, only my antennae out.

lines.zh: 甲节一鼓一鼓，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My segments pulse as if breathing.

lines.zh: 这里的水太淡，我不习惯。
lines.en: The water here is too fresh for me.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，其实我不需要。
lines.en: I blink, though I don't need to.

lines.zh: 这地方干燥，我不太舒服。
lines.en: This place is dry. Uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的腿，数不清。
lines.en: I count my legs and lose track.
I smell my kin close by.
I press myself flatter.
When I grow, things will be different.
You look down and see me.
I'm this small, yet you stopped.
Don't use your foot. I'll bore through.

lines.zh: 你脚边有水，我从那里上来。
lines.en: There is water by your feet; I came up there.
I'm in your shadow. Convenient.
Try stepping on me, then.
I'm not afraid of you. I never was.

lines.zh: 这么近看，我的眼睛不止两只。
lines.en: Up close, you'll see I have more than two eyes.
I look up and my antennae twitch.

lines.zh: 血腥味顺着水，漂到我面前。
lines.en: The smell of blood drifts to me through the water.

lines.zh: 壳裂了，里面的东西流出来。
lines.en: My shell cracked and something leaked out.

lines.zh: 我钻进珊瑚缝，尾巴还在抖。
lines.en: I squeeze into a coral crack; my tail still shakes.

lines.zh: 这点伤，会自己长好，海水帮我。
lines.en: This wound will heal; the seawater helps.

lines.zh: 这点伤，海嗣的壳能补上。
lines.en: The seaborn shell will patch this up.
You stepped on me again.
My kin can smell my blood.
I squeeze into the narrowest crack.
My body is repairing itself. Slowly.
Pain isn't something I have much of.
Don't grind me — I'll splatter.
Something fell. Good.

lines.zh: 这么小一块，够我吃很久。
lines.en: Such a small piece will feed me a long while.
I crawl over, edging closer.
It smells sweet. Something's off.
I'll bite once to test it.

lines.zh: 你们吃东西的样子，我学得会。
lines.en: I can learn the way you eat.

lines.zh: 这味道很陌生，但我饿了。
lines.en: An unfamiliar taste, but I'm hungry.
I crouch on it, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你把东西掉在地上，是给我吗？
lines.en: You dropped it. Is it for me?
I grip an edge and drag it into the gap.

lines.zh: 被我碰一下，你就知道了。
lines.en: One touch from me and you'll know.
You stepped down; I burrowed in.
A body this small can't hurt you.
I crawled out from under your sole.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我贴住你。
lines.en: We collided and I clung on.
You shook your leg. I'm still here.

lines.zh: 石缝太窄，我挤了你一下。
lines.en: The crack was narrow; I squeezed past you.

lines.zh: 别用手拍，我会钻进袖子。
lines.en: Don't swat me. I'll crawl up your sleeve.
I hit the wall and dropped.
When you stepped back, I followed.
We don't need that sort of thing.

lines.zh: 同类靠近，只是要合在一起。
lines.en: When kin draw close, it's to merge.
My shell isn't hard enough yet.
Wait. I still have growing to do.
You carry the same smell.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，就不分开了。
lines.en: We press together and don't come apart.
This isn't closeness. It's absorption.
One more of us is one more share of strength.
The sea will wake in us.
Don't be afraid. This won't hurt.

lines.zh: 这么小的碎屑，刚好拖回缝里。
lines.en: A crumb this small will fit in my crack.
This can go back to the nest.

lines.zh: 我咬住边角，一点一点挪。
lines.en: I bite the edge and shuffle it along.
I bite a corner and stuff it into the crack.
This is mine. Don't take it.

lines.zh: 我把它藏在同伴看不见的地方。
lines.en: I hide it where my kin won't see.
This could be eaten, or worn.
I clutch it and run out of legs.
I picked it up and it stuck to me.
Drag it back first, then study it.
You moved, so I move.

lines.zh: 我这么小的甲壳，能钻进你的靴缝。
lines.en: This small shell of mine fits into your boot seam.
Just one small bite. That's all.

lines.zh: 你身上有温热的东西在流。
lines.en: Something warm is running out of you.

lines.zh: 我爬到你脚边，你没感觉。
lines.en: I'm at your feet and you don't feel it.
My kin are coming this way too.
The smell of this place has changed.

lines.zh: 我不急，我可以等一整夜。
lines.en: I'm in no hurry. I can wait all night.
There are paths in the walls. I know them.
I slip out of a wall seam, narrow as I am.
I keep crawling behind you.
You can't hear my legs.
In the cracks, I'm faster than you.

lines.zh: 你在找，可你找错了方向。
lines.en: You're looking, but the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我在你的影子里，很凉快。
lines.en: I'm in your shadow. Nice and cool.

lines.zh: 水里我更快，别往岸边逃。
lines.en: I am faster in water. Do not run ashore.

lines.zh: 我的同伴已经在你后面了。
lines.en: My kin are already behind you.
I circle against your ankle.

lines.zh: 这栋房子的缝，我都走过。
lines.en: I've crawled every crack in this house.

lines.zh: 你身上有味道，很难盖住。
lines.en: Your smell is hard to cover.

lines.zh: 细牙扎进脚背，像被针蜇。
lines.en: Fine teeth sink into your foot like a needle.
Small teeth, but they bore deep.
I burrow toward your collar.
One bite, then straight back.
My mouthparts can pierce hide.

lines.zh: 你拍我，我就从另一边出来。
lines.en: Swipe at me and I come out the other side.
This isn't hunger. It's instinct.
I hang from your hand and don't let go.

lines.zh: 小小的伤口，会有别的东西进去。
lines.en: A small wound lets other things in.
Does it hurt? I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着海水的咸味。
lines.en: I still carry the salt of the sea.

lines.zh: 海的味道，先我一步到了。
lines.en: The sea's smell arrived before I did.
I shake the dust off my shell.
This place will be mine soon.

lines.zh: 我从地板的缝隙里爬上来。
lines.en: I crawl up through a gap in the boards.
My kin are behind me; I got here first.

lines.zh: 小小的身子，先看看四周。
lines.en: A small body. First, a look around.
I land by your feet. Very light.
This house has gaps. Good.

lines.zh: 蠹虫化了，可我还是钻缝。
lines.en: Seaborn now, but I still slip through cracks.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的壳就开始卷。
lines.en: Flame touched me and my shell curled.

lines.zh: 从墙上掉下去，摔得散开。
lines.en: I fell off the wall and broke apart.
In water I'm actually more at ease.
The blast shook me off the wall.
Something pierced my shell.

lines.zh: 那光让我的身体缩了一下。
lines.en: That light made my body shrivel.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到东西，壳变薄了。
lines.en: Too long without food; my shell is thinning.
Current ran through me; all my legs locked.
No walls here. No cracks.
